text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—On whom will the Goddess of Victory smile 
today! The grand stage to decide the 
pinnacle, the Nippon Derby! Post time is 
finally upon us!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"It'll be quite a spectacle to see if she 
can get results in this Japan Derby and 
pull off the 'MC Rotation'!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S coming off the Aoba Sho is 
definitely a threat too. Still, with 
Gimlet, we've got this, no problem!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's finally about to start...! 
Gim-senpai's Derby...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'm gonna blink...! I'm gonna 
watch every second of Senpai's run!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —It begins: the day of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What awaits ahead is the field of decisive 
battle. All our shackles shall be undone, 
bringing great chaos to heaven and earth 
alike—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And yet, beyond that ruin... lies a 
brilliance so vividly eternal, it 
outshines even the sun!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...It is time for the promise.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hold a goblet within your heart. I shall 
pour you the supreme intoxication.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I'll make this an unforgettable race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Please come back safely. With that 
prayer in my heart, I saw Tanino Gimlet 
off to the arena where the giants gather—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Behold, for I have descended!! Look up 
and revere me!! Ye observers!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. Magnificent passion...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The souls of those who gathered. Their 
resonance is shaking the world, its very 
order, to its core...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yet even in a place like this—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"You are stern and severe. Just like a 
great winter."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Good grief, she's truly terrifying. To 
possess such an immense presence, yet give 
glimpses of an even deeper abyss—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(...Around autumn, perhaps. By then, they 
will have become an even more terrifying 
existence. However—our confrontation is 
now!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome, Kris S. To the end of my 
glorious chronicle of battle.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Those eyes that gaze upon and capture 
me—the waves of that soul. How fitting to 
adorn my very end...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...No matter the stage— it remains 
unchanged...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I will do... what must be done.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Victory, in my grasp.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's fine by you. —In fact, 
that's PRECISELY what makes it good!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Stake your mission on this, Kris S!! 
Staking my very reason for being—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Together with you, I shall destroy 
everything! And bring about the very end!!
